stem: What can be inferred about a wetland that has been disconnected from its natural water flows?
options: It will usually filter pollutants more effectively than a connected wetland.
It may be less effective at absorbing rainfall and reducing flood risk.
It will provide habitat but no benefits related to water management.
It can compensate for the loss of nearby drains and green spaces.

verdicts.working: The passage says a wetland cut off from its natural water flows may provide little protection, so it may be less effective at absorbing rainfall and reducing flood risk.
